Buyer Added Bid Specific Scope Of Work(SOW) Text Clause(s) Section-3: Scope of work & special terms conditions Scope of Work and other Terms & Conditions 1. Scope of Work The Contractor shall undertake complete responsibility on a turnkey basis for handling, application, monitoring, and performanc e optimization of slag modifier within the SMS of SAIL-ASP to ensure effective slag conditioning and improvement in steel ladle q uality as per plant requirements. 1.1 Collection & Handling The Contractor shall collect slag modifier material from designated locations (including pit side, store room, or any other locatio n within the SMS premises) and transport the same to designated application points within SMS at their own cost and responsibil ity. 1.2 Application The Contractor shall ensure timely, accurate, and effective application of slag modifier during Ladle tapping stages as per proce ss requirements and instructions of SAIL-ASP personnel. 1.3 Monitoring The Contractor shall provide round-the-clock monitoring (24x7) of slag modifier application across all shifts, including Sundays a nd holidays, without interruption. 1.4 Coordination The Contractor shall coordinate closely with SAIL-ASP operational personnel & SRU Site In-charge to ensure proper and optimize d application of slag modifier. 1.5 Inspection & Reporting The Contractor shall: · Monitor application results continuously · Immediately report any abnormalities or deviations · Take corrective actions in consultation with SAIL-ASP 1.6 Material Handling & Housekeeping The Contractor shall ensure: · Proper and safe handling of material at all stages · Cleanliness and housekeeping in all work areas 1.7 Record Maintenance The Contractor shall maintain: · Heat-wise consumption records · Daily logs · Weekly and monthly reports, to be submitted to SAIL-ASP, and SRU- Ranchi Road.

1.8 Performance Optimization The Contractor shall: · Optimize slag modifier usage · Reduce consumption without compromising performance · Undertake any additional activities required for improving ladle performance as directed by SAIL-ASP 1.9 Material Availability The Contractor shall ensure: · Continuous availability of slag modifier at point of use · Maintenance of minimum stock levels as per SMS requirements 1.10 Moisture Control The Contractor shall ensure that: · No moisture is present near slag modifier storage or bags · Proper precautions are taken to prevent contamination specially in rainy season 1.11 Turnkey Responsibility The entire job shall be executed on a turnkey basis, and no additional claims shall be entertained for any activity required to ful fil the scope. 1.12 Equipment & Tools The Contractor shall arrange, maintain, and deploy all required tools, tackles, and equipment at their own cost. 1.13 Manpower Deployment The Contractor shall: · Deploy adequate manpower to ensure uninterrupted coverage across all three shifts · Provide at least one dedicated supervisor during the general shift · Ensure manpower competency and discipline 1.14 Loss Prevention The Contractor shall be fully responsible for: · Preventing material loss or damage · Any loss arising out of improper handling, storage, or application · Penalty shall be applicable for any such loss. 2. Transportation · Transportation of materials from SRU–Ranchi Road to SAIL-ASP stores shall be arranged by SRU–Ranchi Road. · Transportation from ASP refractory stores to SMS shall normally be arranged by SAIL-ASP. · However, under exigent conditions, the Contractor shall arrange transportation from ASP stores to SMS at no extra cost. 3. Packing

· Materials shall be suitably packed by SRU–Ranchi Road to prevent damage during transit and storage. · In case of damage during transit, the Contractor shall repack/stack the materials at ASP stores free of cost. 4. Marking · Proper identification and marking on all packages shall have to be ensured by Contractor after packing in small bags/ jumbo ba gs. · SRU–Ranchi Road shall not be responsible for any dispute arising due to absence or illegibility of marking. 5. Consumption Ratio The Contractor shall maintain proportional and controlled consumption of slag modifier as per approved norms. 7. Quantity Variation The contract quantity may vary within ±20%. 8. Validity Extension The contract may be extended for a period of up to six (6) months on the same terms and conditions, at the discretion of SAIL-A SP. 9. Penalty & Recovery SRU- Ranchi Road reserves the right to impose penalties and recover costs for: · Improper application – Rs. 1000 per instance. · Material loss or misuse - Rs. 20000 per MT of material lost or mis-used. · Operational disruption attributable to the Contractor - Rs. 1000 per instance. Certification of the above will be done by ASP and /or Site in-charge of SRU at ASP and will be final for deductions as per above. 10. Safety The Contractor shall strictly comply with all SAIL-ASP safety rules and regulations, including: · Use of PPE · Safe handling practices · Compliance with statutory safety requirements · Any violation may lead to penalty or termination. 11. Payment of Workers The Contractor shall be solely responsible for: · Payment of wages · Statutory dues (PF, ESI, etc.) · Compliance with all applicable labour laws · SRU- Ranchi Road shall bear no responsibility in this regard. 12. Certification of Quantity: · The monthly certification of quantity of Slag modifier used in Ladles will be provided by Site in charge of SRU at ASP. · Daily consumption of Slag modifier per ladle basis to be recorded and shared with SRU Ranchi Raod and site incharge of SRU a

t ASP. · Data of the same to be maintained as per format provided by SRU. Special Condition All tools, tackles, and equipment required for execution of the job shall be arranged by the Contractor at their own cost, and no additional payment shall be made by SRU- Ranchi Road on this account. ANY OTHER CONDITIONS : Contractor shall adhere to the procedure for addition of slag modifier in ladle as per guidelines of Executing authority. JOB EXECUTION SCHEDULE :Commencement of the job to be done within 10 days after placement of LOA/work order and therea fter as per ASP’s requirement.
